root_cause: The dialog's _showElement method opens the dialog via showModal()/show() but does not explicitly focus the element with the autofocus attribute, causing keyboard focus to remain on the trigger button or body instead of moving into the drawer.
repair_strategy: After showing the dialog in _showElement, explicitly focus the autofocus element (or fall back to the dialog itself) so keyboard users land inside the drawer immediately.
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard focus moves into the drawer when opened, landing on the search field so users can immediately type or Tab to filters without a pointer.
functional_risks: Potential focus theft if autofocus element is not focusable (mitigated by fallback).
Risk of double-focus if browser already moved focus (mitigated by checking activeElement).
verification_requirements: After activating the drawer button with Enter, focus is on #filters-search.
Pressing Tab moves focus to #in-stock checkbox.
Closing the drawer with Escape returns focus to the trigger button.
